correctness.rationale: Every long-success-run indicator forces its own success-run start and forbids other starts at positions j-1 through j+k. Outside that interval the start indicators use disjoint bits and are independent. Summing exact local covariances proves the stated finite polynomial and separate n=k boundary. Endpoint values and upward concavity, with a k=2 factorization, prove two interior roots iff n>2k and every exception. The packaged standard-library checker independently exhausts words through length 12 (198 exact-rational moment identities), 3002 numerical root classifications and 37 limiting-root comparisons; these are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: It settles a natural dependence question for counts of all maximal success runs versus counts exceeding a prespecified duration, with an exact n,k,p phase diagram. The second switch arises exactly at the first length permitting two separated long runs; the k=2 negative window collapses at a sharp order 1/n rate. This is a meaningful all-parameter finite classification rather than a routine numerical table, trivial corollary or one arbitrary slice.
